name: First Solar Louisiana
old_description: First Solar’s roots run deep in American soil. Born in the Midwest, headquartered in the Southwest, and shipped worldwide, First Solar is an American success story. Driven by a passion for innovation and powered by American ingenuity, First Solar has consistently invested in American manufacturing and American jobs. Today, it is the only US-headquartered company among the world’s largest module producers.
about:
First Solar Louisiana operates a manufacturing facility in New Iberia, Louisiana, as part of First Solar, a U.S.-headquartered photovoltaic manufacturer. The parent company traces its origins to the Midwest and now directs global operations from the Southwest, shipping solar modules worldwide while emphasizing domestic production and job creation.

The facility produces the company's Series 6 and Series 7 thin-film photovoltaic modules, which are built on a proprietary cadmium telluride (CdTe) semiconductor process. In addition to module manufacturing, the operation supports a full ecosystem that includes recycling services, post-sales support, and mounting hardware featuring the SpeedSlot system designed to reduce installation time and hardware costs. Specific facility size, headcount, and annual output figures are not disclosed.

The modules serve the solar photovoltaic and broader renewable-energy sectors, targeting utility-scale developers, commercial and industrial installers, and residential markets. The Series 7 TR1 line is marketed as "Made in America, for America," indicating a focus on domestic content requirements and U.S. energy projects.

First Solar differentiates itself through its CdTe thin-film technology, which it says yields a lower carbon footprint, lower water footprint, and faster energy payback than conventional crystalline silicon panels. The company warrants an annual degradation rate of 0.3 percent and offers what it describes as the industry's only cell-cracking warranty, positioning its product as a lower-risk, higher-lifetime-energy option.
